about_the_game:
Samara is a semi–open world psychological horror game inspired by Thai beliefs and folklore, blending elements of mystery and dark fantasy.

You play as a high school student who, along with your classmates, has been assigned to serve a punishment trip to clean up an abandoned rural school for three days.

But as night falls, strange things begin to happen.
Each night, one of your friends disappears without a trace. While searching for them, you are suddenly attacked—and killed.

Yet, instead of dying…
you wake up again on the first day.

Caught in an endless time loop, you must uncover the truth, and find the murderer.
Every decision you make—every conversation, every discovery—can lead to a different path.

Will you save your friends and escape together?
Or will your choices lead to a different ending altogether?

Features

  • 🌙 Semi–open world exploration — freely investigate the school and its surroundings at your own pace.

  • 🔁 Time loop system — relive the same three days with new knowledge each time.

  • 🧩 Multiple endings — your actions shape the story’s outcome.

  • 💬 Meaningful choices — dialogue and decisions affect relationships and future events.

  • 🔒 Secrets to uncover — hidden storylines, lost notes, and strange phenomena waiting to be found.

content_descriptors.notes: This Game may contain content not appropriate for all ages: Unrealistic Violence, Fear, Depiction of Suicide

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit or higher
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2300 2.8 GHz / AMD FX-6300, 3.5 GHz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 970
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit or higher
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-3770 | AMD FX-8350
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce RTX 3060
  • DirectX: Version 11

  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible
